item.title: Magic Just Revealed 19 New Cards From 2027’s First Set — Including a $30 Reprint With Stunning Art
item.description: Magic: The Gathering is heading underwater, and we’ve just gotten a closer look at what’s lurking in the depths of a new plane called Nauctis. During Friday’s preview panel at MagicCon : Atlanta, Wizards of the Coast revealed 19 cards from Nauctis: The Sunken Realm (including different art variants), the upcoming set that introduces an ocean plane to Magic ’s Multiverse. Launching on Feb. 5, 2027, the set trades typical fantasy settings like Dominaria or Ikoria for sprawling underwater cities and aquatic creatures, with greater dangers waiting farther below the surface.

item.title: How Queen's Domain's 2-Person Team Remade Elden Ring's Legacy in a Basement
item.description: At Final Strike Games, Berger met Bradley Boothe, a technical artist and former software engineer who shared a frustration with what could get done at a traditional studio. Together, they struck out on their own, founding the two-person indie studio Freshly Baked Games and trading the security of industry jobs for the creative freedom — and financial uncertainty — of building something entirely theirs. Many years later, the result was a prototype for a game… that was way too ambitious (but they fully intend to return to). So they went back to a different concept, a stripped-down first-person fantasy inspired by FromSoftware's cult-classic King's Field . That was supposed to take a year to build. Three years later, the game, Queen’s Domain , is an ambitious torrent of weaponry, monster encounters, and Berger’s patented 3D level design, all spread across an low-poly open-world map.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Animated Series Officially Gets First Trailer
item.description: Magic: The Gathering is finally getting a TV show, and publisher Wizards of the Coast just debuted the first official look at the animated series during its MagicCon Atlanta preview panel. While the first half of Wizards' stream focused on next February’s Nauctis: The Sunken Realm set, the second half was targeted at those who “love Magic’s multiverse.”

item.title: VisionQuest’s Wild Post-Credits Cameo Almost Didn’t Happen
item.description: If you haven't already heard about the shocking return of a fan-favorite Avenger at the end of VisionQuest , then you should beware spoilers ahead. For everyone who hasn't been under a rock, the latest Marvel series made waves this week by reviving Wanda Maximoff in a post-credits scene. That bombshell has dominated the conversation around the show's conclusion as it sets up a fascinating conflict in Avengers: Doomsday .

item.title: All rupee wallet upgrade locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: Upgrading the r upee wallet allows you to hold five times the original amount of rupees in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. As things have gotten a bit pricier Hyrule, you'll need a larger rupee wallet if you want to purchase everything you need, like the abilities given to you by the Great Fairies .

item.title: Dragon Age Modders Are Rushing to Save the Series’ Most Iconic Feature
item.description: One of the Dragon Age series' most well-known features is now safe, thanks to the efforts of a modder. After EA shut down BioWare a few weeks ago , many fans realized the studio’s closure probably meant it would soon become impossible to easily port save data between all the games.

item.title: Walmart's Black Friday Deals: 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary and TCG Surprises
item.description: Black Friday is coming early for Walmart shoppers who like to play or collect the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The retailer is stocking a few TCG products beginning on Thursday, Nov. 12, including the hard-to-find Pokémon 30th Anniversary set. The retailer will also continue the discounted festivities later in Nov. with an additional Pokémon TCG drop.

item.title: Sony Officially Confirms New Platform for 2026 God of War Game
item.description: God of War fans were treated to a surprise new game earlier this year. The retro-stylized Metroidvania God of War Sons of Sparta shadow-dropped during February's State of Play stream alongside the announcement that the original trilogy is getting remade . Sons of Sparta was released as a PlayStation 5 exclusive, but that will no longer be the case next week.

item.title: Stephen King and Real-Life Serial Killers Shaped the Most Unhinged Thriller of 2026
item.description: After a decade of surviving monsters onscreen, Maika Monroe gets her hands dirty in Victorian Psycho. Directed by Zachary Wigon ( Sanctuary ) and based on the Virginia Feito novel, the movie is set in the mid-1800s, our most hysterical era, and follows Winifred Notty (Monroe), a newly hired governess who arrives at a gothic manor to tutor the Pounds’ children (Jacobi Jupe and Evie Templeton). Upon her arrival, staff members begin to vanish, building up to a bloody climax.

item.title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A Changes into a Weirdly Restrictive Game this Week
item.description: On Thursday, Pokémon developer Game Freak started giving Pokémon Legends: Z-A players a free shiny Xerneas , the legendary introduced in Pokémon X . That gift will come in handy for the new season of Legends: Z-A 's multiplayer, which has a very restrictive ruleset for what Pokémon can be used.
